telme-erasmus-mundus-2027.about:
TELME is an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master (EMJM) in Teaching and Managing Foreign Language Learning for Multicultural and Inclusive Environments. A joint master's for language teachers and designers of language-learning programmes in multicultural and inclusive settings. It is coordinated by Université Rennes 2 in Rennes (France); the consortium: Université Rennes 2 (France), Åbo Akademi University (Finland), University of Limerick (Ireland), University of Burgos (Spain) and Adam Mickiewicz University Poznań (Poland). Students move between partner universities and graduate with a joint or multiple degree.

Who it is for: Bachelor's in languages, linguistics, education or related; B2 in both languages of the chosen track; one application per track. Applicants of any nationality can apply, including citizens of Georgia and Qatar.

Timeline: Official site: applications for September 2027 entry run 3 Oct 2026 to 10 Jan 2027; about 12 EU scholarships. Erasmus Mundus scholarships go to the top-ranked applicants and cover all participation costs (tuition and insurance) plus €1,400 a month for up to 24 months. Duration: 2 years (120 ECTS), from September 2027.
highlights: Full EU-funded Erasmus Mundus scholarship: tuition covered + €1,400/month for up to 24 months
Joint master's across France, Finland, Ireland, Spain and Poland, coordinated by Université Rennes 2
telme-erasmus-mundus-2027.eligibility: Open to all nationalities, including citizens of Georgia and Qatar: Erasmus Mundus scholarships are awarded worldwide on merit, but anyone who has already held an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master scholarship cannot receive another. Requirements: Bachelor's in languages, linguistics, education or related; B2 in both languages of the chosen track; one application per track.
how_to_apply: Read the official admission, eligibility and scholarship pages for the 2027 intake

Prepare your bachelor's diploma (or proof of final-year enrolment) and transcripts, English test or exemption, CV, motivation letter, references and any programme-specific items (portfolio, video, proof of residence)
Submit the online application at https://telme.hypotheses.org/ before 10 January 2027
Make sure you are considered for an Erasmus Mundus scholarship (tick the option or apply in the scholarship round)
Attend an online interview if shortlisted; results usually come in March–April 2027
telme-erasmus-mundus-2027.costs: Erasmus Mundus scholarship (EU-funded, full): participation costs (tuition and insurance) are waived and you receive €1,400 a month for up to 24 months (2026 rate) toward living, travel, visa and installation costs. Self-funded admitted students pay the consortium's participation fee.

terra-erasmus-mundus-2027.about:
TERRA is an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master (EMJM) in Earthen Architecture and Construction. A European master on earthen architecture and construction: building with earth, conservation of earthen heritage and low-carbon construction. It is coordinated by University of Minho in Guimarães (Portugal); the consortium: University of Minho (Portugal), Universitat Politècnica de Valencia (Spain), ENTPE Lyon (France) and University of Florence (Italy). Students move between partner universities and graduate with a joint or multiple degree.

Who it is for: Degree in civil engineering, architecture or equivalent with 240 ECTS (300 ECTS for the Florence track) and proof of English. Applicants of any nationality can apply, including citizens of Georgia and Qatar.

Timeline: Official applications page: first call for 2027/28 closes 15 Jan 2027 and is the only call with EU (Erasmus Mundus) scholarships; later calls 15 Apr and 15 Jun 2027. Erasmus Mundus scholarships go to the top-ranked applicants and cover all participation costs (tuition and insurance) plus €1,400 a month for up to 24 months. Duration: 2 years (120 ECTS), from September 2027.
highlights: Full EU-funded Erasmus Mundus scholarship: tuition covered + €1,400/month for up to 24 months
Joint master's across Portugal, Spain, France and Italy, coordinated by University of Minho
terra-erasmus-mundus-2027.eligibility: Open to all nationalities, including citizens of Georgia and Qatar: Erasmus Mundus scholarships are awarded worldwide on merit, but anyone who has already held an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master scholarship cannot receive another. Requirements: Degree in civil engineering, architecture or equivalent with 240 ECTS (300 ECTS for the Florence track) and proof of English.
how_to_apply: Read the official admission, eligibility and scholarship pages for the 2027 intake

Prepare your bachelor's diploma (or proof of final-year enrolment) and transcripts, English test or exemption, CV, motivation letter, references and any programme-specific items (portfolio, video, proof of residence)
Submit the online application at https://msc-terra.org/applications/ before 15 January 2027
Make sure you are considered for an Erasmus Mundus scholarship (tick the option or apply in the scholarship round)
Attend an online interview if shortlisted; results usually come in March–April 2027
terra-erasmus-mundus-2027.costs: Erasmus Mundus scholarship (EU-funded, full): participation costs (tuition and insurance) are waived and you receive €1,400 a month for up to 24 months (2026 rate) toward living, travel, visa and installation costs. Self-funded admitted students pay the consortium's participation fee.

theatre-spaces-erasmus-mundus-2027.about:
Theatre SPACEs is an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master (EMJM) in Theatre in Social, Participatory, Community and Educational Contexts. A joint master's in applied and participatory theatre: theatre in schools, communities, social work and activism. It is coordinated by Western Norway University of Applied Sciences (HVL) in Bergen (Norway); the consortium: HVL (Norway), Trinity College Dublin (Ireland) and University of Arts Târgu Mureș (Romania), with associated partners University of Hamburg and DAMU Prague. Students move between partner universities and graduate with a joint or multiple degree.

Who it is for: Bachelor's in theatre, drama, education or a related field with practical experience; English proficiency (see admission page). Applicants of any nationality can apply, including citizens of Georgia and Qatar.

Timeline: Official site: applications for the 2027 intake are open; Erasmus Mundus scholarship deadline 1 Dec 2026. Erasmus Mundus scholarships go to the top-ranked applicants and cover all participation costs (tuition and insurance) plus €1,400 a month for up to 24 months. Duration: 2 years (120 ECTS, joint degree, at least three countries).
highlights: Full EU-funded Erasmus Mundus scholarship: tuition covered + €1,400/month for up to 24 months
Joint master's across Norway, Ireland and Romania, coordinated by Western Norway University of Applied Sciences (HVL)
theatre-spaces-erasmus-mundus-2027.eligibility: Open to all nationalities, including citizens of Georgia and Qatar: Erasmus Mundus scholarships are awarded worldwide on merit, but anyone who has already held an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master scholarship cannot receive another. Requirements: Bachelor's in theatre, drama, education or a related field with practical experience; English proficiency (see admission page).
how_to_apply: Read the official admission, eligibility and scholarship pages for the 2027 intake

Prepare your bachelor's diploma (or proof of final-year enrolment) and transcripts, English test or exemption, CV, motivation letter, references and any programme-specific items (portfolio, video, proof of residence)
Submit the online application at https://www.theatre-spaces.eu/admission before 1 December 2026
Make sure you are considered for an Erasmus Mundus scholarship (tick the option or apply in the scholarship round)
Attend an online interview if shortlisted; results usually come in March–April 2027
theatre-spaces-erasmus-mundus-2027.costs: Erasmus Mundus scholarship (EU-funded, full): participation costs (tuition and insurance) are waived and you receive €1,400 a month for up to 24 months (2026 rate) toward living, travel, visa and installation costs. Self-funded admitted students pay the consortium's participation fee.

tohoku-university-international-student-.about:
Tohoku University in Sendai, a top-5 Japanese national university, is replacing its need-based tuition exemption with a new merit scholarship for international students enrolling from the 2027 academic year. It covers either the full tuition fee or half of it and is expected to reach approximately the top one-third of admitted students, judged on entrance examination results and academic performance.

For bachelor's students the main English route is the Future Global Leadership (FGL) programme: Advanced Molecular Chemistry, International Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, and Applied Marine Biology, with October entry and applications in January. FGL applicants may also be considered for MEXT university-recommended scholarships (up to 8 places) and the President Fellowship. Tohoku says full rules will be announced on its website once finalised.
highlights: Full or half tuition for ~top third of admits
Applies to bachelor's, master's and professional degrees
English-taught FGL bachelor's: apply in January
tohoku-university-international-student-.eligibility: International students enrolling at Tohoku from the 2027 academic year in undergraduate, master's or professional-degree programmes. Selection by entrance results and grades. No nationality restriction stated.
how_to_apply: Choose an English-taught programme (e.g. FGL for bachelor's)
Apply in the programme's window (FGL: January for October entry)
Tick scholarship preference on the online application
Watch Tohoku's website for the scholarship's final rules
tohoku-university-international-student-.costs: Full tuition (≈¥535,800/year) or 50%; FGL scholars may also get MEXT stipends of ¥119,000/month.

trent-international-prestigious-scholars.about:
Trent University in Peterborough, Ontario, a small liberal-arts-style university, offers International Prestigious Scholarships that cover tuition and mandatory ancillary fees up to CA$15,000 a year. Named awards include the Justin Chiu International Scholarship (up to CA$60,000 for students from Asia), the Moore Family International Scholarship (up to CA$48,000, three students from outside North America), the Charmaine Eddy Scholarship for BIPOC students and the Daniel Powell Scholarship for Latin American students.

One application in the Trent Applicant Portal (Finances > International) covers every award you qualify for; it opens on 1 November and closes on 15 February at 11:59 pm EST. All international applicants also get automatic entrance scholarships of CA$10,000–22,000 over four years for averages of 80% or more.
highlights: Up to CA$60,000 over four years
One application for all named awards
trent-international-prestigious-scholars.eligibility: International fee-paying students starting an undergraduate degree in summer or fall 2027 (not winter) with at least an 80% average (75% for the Eddy award). Some awards are region-specific. Georgia and Qatar citizens may apply.
how_to_apply: Apply to Trent through OUAC or the Trent international application
Log in to the Trent Applicant Portal and open Finances > International
Complete the prestigious scholarship application between 1 Nov 2026 and 15 Feb 2027
Meet your offer conditions and pay first-year fees
trent-international-prestigious-scholars.costs: Up to CA$15,000 per year toward tuition and ancillary fees, renewable with an 80% average; plus automatic CA$2,500–5,500/year entrance awards.

tufts-financial-aid-international-2027.about:
Tufts University, near Boston, meets 100% of the demonstrated financial need of every admitted student regardless of citizenship. Aid is need-based only (no merit scholarships), and admission for international aid applicants is need-aware, so you must say you are applying for aid when you apply; you cannot ask later, and internationals who get no aid in year one cannot receive it in later years.

For 2027-28 you submit the CSS Profile (or Tufts' International Student Financial Aid Application if the College Board cannot accept your Profile) and 2025 foreign tax returns, translated and converted to US dollars, through IDOC. Deadlines: ED I 16 November 2026, ED II 15 January 2027, Regular Decision 1 February 2027.
highlights: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for internationals
Need-aware: request aid when you apply
CSS Profile by 16 Nov (ED I) or 1 Feb (RD)
tufts-financial-aid-international-2027.eligibility: International first-year applicants to Tufts for fall 2027 who request aid at the time of application. All nationalities, including Georgia and Qatar.
how_to_apply: Apply to Tufts (Common App) and indicate you are applying for aid
Submit the 2027-28 CSS Profile (or ISFAA) by 16 Nov / 15 Jan / 1 Feb depending on round
Upload translated 2025 tax/income documents to IDOC two weeks later
Reapply for aid every year
tufts-financial-aid-international-2027.costs: Up to full cost of attendance (≈$90,000/yr) through grants and work, based on need.

uoregon-international-cultural-service-p.about:
The University of Oregon in Eugene runs the International Cultural Service Program (ICSP): a partial tuition scholarship, renewable until you finish one degree, for international students who combine financial need, academic merit and the ability to present to diverse audiences. Recipients give presentations about their home countries to schools and community groups.

UO also offers Division of Global Engagement Endowed Scholarships (about $1,000–12,000), an International Student Work-Study Program ($1,000–4,500 a year, 50+ awards), and automatic consideration for the General University Scholarship Program for freshmen who apply by 15 January. Admission materials, including test scores, should arrive by 15 February.
uoregon-international-cultural-service-p.eligibility: International undergraduate applicants with financial need and good grades; ICSP requires a separate application. All nationalities, including Georgia and Qatar.
how_to_apply: Apply to UO for fall 2027 by 15 January 2027
Submit the ICSP application
Send all admission materials (incl. test scores) by 15 February
Ask your admissions counsellor about endowed scholarships
uoregon-international-cultural-service-p.costs: Partial tuition (ICSP); endowed awards $1,000–12,000; work-study $1,000–4,500 a year.

uppsala-university-global-scholarship-20.about:
Uppsala University, Sweden's oldest university and a top-100 institution, awards the Uppsala University Global Scholarship to academically talented citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland. It covers the full tuition fee of an international master's programme; living costs are not included. About 2% of applicants receive a scholarship, so it is highly competitive.

The Uppsala programme must be your first priority at University Admissions in Sweden, and your application, fee and documents must arrive by the national deadline (15 January 2027). The scholarship application then runs from 16 January to 1 February 2027. Some Nordic and joint master's programmes are excluded.
highlights: Full tuition for the whole master's
uppsala-university-global-scholarship-20.eligibility: Citizens of non-EU/EEA countries (not Switzerland) who pay tuition and rank an Uppsala international master's programme first. Georgia and Qatar citizens may apply.
how_to_apply: Apply at universityadmissions.se by 15 Jan 2027 with Uppsala as first priority
Pay the application fee and upload documents on time
Submit the Uppsala scholarship application 16 Jan – 1 Feb 2027
Results come with or after admission results
uppsala-university-global-scholarship-20.costs: Full tuition fee (SEK 145,000–310,000 per year depending on programme); no living allowance.

uregina-international-student-of-distinc.about:
The International Student of Distinction (ISD) Scholarship at the University of Regina, Saskatchewan, pays for on-campus housing (and, at Tier 1, the meal plan) rather than tuition. Tier 1, for a final or early conditional high-school average of 90%+, is worth about CA$22,500 a year for four years (≈CA$90,000); Tier 2, for 85–89.99%, is about CA$11,250 a year (≈CA$45,000).

You are considered automatically if you apply directly from high school and submit all documents by the intake deadline (30 April for fall). All international undergraduate applicants with 83%+ also receive a CA$5,000 International Entrance Scholarship, and new international students get a CA$5,000-per-year bursary. Winter and spring 2027 ISD places are full, so aim for fall 2027.
highlights: Up to ≈CA$90,000 in housing and meals
uregina-international-student-of-distinc.eligibility: International students applying directly from high school to a Regina undergraduate degree, with 85%+ average (Canadian equivalent). Renewal needs 24 credit hours per year and 80% average. All nationalities, including Georgia and Qatar.
how_to_apply: Apply to a University of Regina undergraduate programme for fall 2027
Submit transcripts and all supporting documents by 30 April 2027
Apply for residence by 15 June
Watch for the award in your admission package
uregina-international-student-of-distinc.costs: Tier 1: ≈CA$22,500/year housing + meals; Tier 2: ≈CA$11,250/year housing. Tuition is not covered (other awards help).

usask-international-entrance-awards-2027.about:
The University of Saskatchewan in Saskatoon, a U15 research university strong in agriculture, health sciences and engineering, considers international applicants automatically for its international entrance awards: the USask International Excellence Award (CA$10,000, based on academic achievement) and International Baccalaureate Excellence Awards (CA$20,000 each) for international students completing the IB Diploma.

To be eligible you must apply for admission by 15 February. Further international awards (CA$10,000–15,000) with a 1 May deadline are mostly for internationals already studying in western Canadian provinces. Offers are emailed from late April.
usask-international-entrance-awards-2027.eligibility: International students applying directly to a USask undergraduate programme; IB awards require the IB Diploma. All nationalities, including Georgia and Qatar.
how_to_apply: Apply to USask by 15 February 2027
Submit transcripts and IB predictions/results
Awards are considered automatically
Accept the emailed offer by the stated deadline

usc-merit-scholarships-international-202.about:
The University of Southern California in Los Angeles awards merit scholarships to first-year applicants regardless of citizenship: the Trustee Scholarship (full tuition for eight semesters), the Presidential Scholarship (half tuition), Deans Scholarships and fixed-value awards such as the Associates and Leadership scholarships. You receive only the highest-value award; none covers the full cost of attendance.

There is no separate form: applying by the early deadline (1 November 2026 for most majors, 1 December for some performing-arts majors) puts you in consideration. International applicants must still submit a financial statement with the application. Need-based aid for internationals is very limited.
highlights: Full or half tuition for top applicants
usc-merit-scholarships-international-202.eligibility: International first-year applicants to USC for fall 2027 who submit the application by 1 Nov 2026 (or 1 Dec for designated arts majors). All nationalities, including Georgia and Qatar.
how_to_apply: Complete the Common App with USC supplements by 1 November 2026
Submit transcripts, recommendations and (optional) test scores
Upload the international financial statement
Selected Trustee/Presidential finalists are invited to interview
usc-merit-scholarships-international-202.costs: Trustee: full tuition (≈$70,000/yr); Presidential: half tuition; other awards fixed amounts.

usf-green-and-gold-international-scholar.about:
The University of South Florida in Tampa, a large public research university, awards merit tuition waivers to a limited number of admitted international freshmen: the Green and Gold Presidential Waiver (≈$44,000 total, up to $11,000/year), Directors Waiver (≈$36,000) and Scholars Waiver (≈$20,000), plus separate out-of-state tuition waivers.

No separate application is needed. Awards are based on the same records used for admission, and you are notified by post. To be considered for summer or fall 2027 you must complete the freshman application, including transcripts, test scores and the fee, by 15 January 2027.
usf-green-and-gold-international-scholar.eligibility: International first-year applicants admitted to USF for summer/fall 2027 with strong academic records. All nationalities, including Georgia and Qatar.
how_to_apply: Submit the USF freshman application
Send transcripts and SAT/ACT scores
Pay the application fee and complete the file by 15 January 2027
Watch for the award letter by post
usf-green-and-gold-international-scholar.costs: Tuition waivers of ≈$5,000–11,000 per year; housing, meals and books not covered.

utoledo-international-rocket-award-2027.about:
The University of Toledo in Ohio says more than 85% of its international undergraduates receive scholarships or special tuition rates. The International Rocket Award is $8,000 per academic year for admitted international students with a GPA of 3.0 or higher; it applies to the out-of-state surcharge and needs no separate application.

Students whose permanent address is in one of Toledo's sister cities pay Ohio resident tuition instead (not combinable with the Rocket Award). Departmental awards such as the Shapiro Scholarship (economics) and the Levis Leadership Award also exist. International tuition and fees are about $24,000 a year before awards.
highlights: Low total cost (~$24k tuition before award)
utoledo-international-rocket-award-2027.eligibility: Admitted international undergraduates with GPA 3.0+. All nationalities, including Georgia and Qatar.
how_to_apply: Apply to UToledo
Submit transcripts showing GPA 3.0+
Receive the award with admission
utoledo-international-rocket-award-2027.costs: $8,000 per year toward the non-resident surcharge.

uwindsor-global-lancer-scholarship-2027.about:
The University of Windsor, on the Canada–US border in Ontario, gives the Global Lancer Scholarship to every international undergraduate entering directly from full-time secondary school and paying international tuition. In the 2026–27 scale it is worth CA$24,000 for a 95%+ final average, CA$20,000 for 90–94.99%, CA$10,000 for 80–89.99% and CA$4,000 below 80%, renewable with a 70% cumulative average.

No application is required; you are considered when you apply to a qualifying programme. Windsor also runs application-based skills awards (Science Olympiad, FIRST Robotics, science fair) with an entrance profile due 30 April. Check the 2027–28 regulations when they are posted, as values may change.
highlights: Strong engineering, business and computer science
uwindsor-global-lancer-scholarship-2027.eligibility: International students paying international fees and entering first year directly from secondary school. All nationalities, including Georgia and Qatar.
how_to_apply: Apply for undergraduate admission to Windsor
Send final/predicted grades
Receive the scholarship amount with your offer
Keep a 70% average to renew

vmu-tuition-waivers-priority-countries-2.about:
Vytautas Magnus University (VMU), a liberal-arts style university in Kaunas, Lithuania, offers tuition waivers of 25%, 50%, 75% or 90% for full-time English-taught bachelor's and master's programmes to applicants from a list of priority countries, which includes several Caucasus, Central Asian, Southeast Asian and Latin American countries, Ukraine, and foreigners of Lithuanian origin. You need a GPA of at least 85%, English at B2 or higher and a (conditional) letter of acceptance.

In the 2026 cycle applications opened on 15 March and the main deadline was 15 April, with an additional call in May; VMU states that 2027/2028 details will be posted by 15 February 2027. Smaller automatic waivers exist for former exchange students and family members of alumni.
highlights: Priority list includes the Caucasus and Central Asia
vmu-tuition-waivers-priority-countries-2.eligibility: Applicants from VMU's priority-country list (Caucasus, Central Asia, Southeast Asia, Latin America, Ukraine; master's list also includes EU/EEA and some East Asian countries) with GPA ≥85%, English B2+ and an acceptance letter. Check the 2027 list for Georgia; Qatar is not on the 2026 list.
how_to_apply: Apply for admission to an English-taught VMU degree
Obtain a (conditional) letter of acceptance
Submit the waiver application in the spring window (2026: 15 March–15 April)
Wait for results in May
vmu-tuition-waivers-priority-countries-2.costs: 25%, 50%, 75% or 90% of tuition; living costs not covered.

wellesley-financial-aid-international-20.about:
Wellesley College near Boston, a leading women's liberal arts college, meets the full calculated need of admitted students, including international students, through grants and work. International students do not file the FAFSA; the CSS Profile determines need, and parents with income outside the US or Canada submit translated tax returns or employer statements.

Deadlines for international first-year applicants are 1 November (Early Decision I), 5 January (Early Decision II) and 8 January 2027 (Regular Decision).
wellesley-financial-aid-international-20.eligibility: Female international first-year applicants to Wellesley for fall 2027. All nationalities, including Georgia and Qatar.
how_to_apply: Apply to Wellesley (Common App)
Submit the CSS Profile by 1 Nov, 5 Jan or 8 Jan 2027 depending on round
Upload translated income documents
Check your MyWellesley portal for missing items

wintour-erasmus-mundus-2027.about:
WINTOUR is an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master (EMJM) in Wine Tourism Transitions and Innovations. A master's on wine tourism and wine-region development: tourism management, oenology, sustainability and innovation in wine territories. It is coordinated by Universitat Rovira i Virgili in Tarragona (Spain); the consortium: Universitat Rovira i Virgili (Spain), Université de Bordeaux (France) and University of Porto (Portugal). Students move between partner universities and graduate with a joint or multiple degree.

Who it is for: Bachelor's in tourism, business, oenology, agriculture, geography, social sciences or related; English proficiency (see application step-by-step page). Applicants of any nationality can apply, including citizens of Georgia and Qatar.

Timeline: Official apply page: edition 2027-2029, 1st call (Erasmus Mundus scholarship candidates) 10 Nov to 17 Dec 2026, 23:59 CET; 2027-2029 is the last intake with EMJM scholarships in the current funding period (15-19 per edition). Erasmus Mundus scholarships go to the top-ranked applicants and cover all participation costs (tuition and insurance) plus €1,400 a month for up to 24 months. Duration: 2 years (120 ECTS).
highlights: Full EU-funded Erasmus Mundus scholarship: tuition covered + €1,400/month for up to 24 months
Joint master's across Spain, France and Portugal, coordinated by Universitat Rovira i Virgili
wintour-erasmus-mundus-2027.eligibility: Open to all nationalities, including citizens of Georgia and Qatar: Erasmus Mundus scholarships are awarded worldwide on merit, but anyone who has already held an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master scholarship cannot receive another. Requirements: Bachelor's in tourism, business, oenology, agriculture, geography, social sciences or related; English proficiency (see application step-by-step page).
how_to_apply: Read the official admission, eligibility and scholarship pages for the 2027 intake

Prepare your bachelor's diploma (or proof of final-year enrolment) and transcripts, English test or exemption, CV, motivation letter, references and any programme-specific items (portfolio, video, proof of residence)
Submit the online application at https://www.wintour-master.eu/en/apply/ before 17 December 2026
Make sure you are considered for an Erasmus Mundus scholarship (tick the option or apply in the scholarship round)
Attend an online interview if shortlisted; results usually come in March–April 2027
wintour-erasmus-mundus-2027.costs: Erasmus Mundus scholarship (EU-funded, full): participation costs (tuition and insurance) are waived and you receive €1,400 a month for up to 24 months (2026 rate) toward living, travel, visa and installation costs. Self-funded admitted students pay the consortium's participation fee.

24-pull-requests-2026.about:
24 Pull Requests is a long-running community project encouraging people to give back to open source during December. From 1 to 24 December you aim to send a pull request (or other contribution such as documentation, design, triage or user support) to open-source projects each day; the site suggests beginner-friendly projects and tracks your contributions.

More than 27,000 organisations have been involved. It is free, informal and ideal for students who want to practise Git and GitHub, collaborate with maintainers and strengthen their CV before applying to programmes such as Google Summer of Code or Outreachy. Organisers can also host local 24 Pull Requests hack events.
highlights: One contribution a day through December
24-pull-requests-2026.eligibility: Anyone with a GitHub account (GitHub requires users to be at least 13).
how_to_apply: Sign in to 24pullrequests.com with GitHub
Pick projects in languages you know
Open a pull request or contribution each day from 1 Dec
Track your progress on your profile

aarhus-summer-university-2027.about:
AU Summer University brings about 2,500 students from 60+ countries to Aarhus, Denmark's second city, each summer. In 2027 there are two three-week terms (5–23 July and 26 July – 13 August) with 85+ English-taught courses from business and social sciences to nanoscience and biotechnology, taught by active researchers and worth 5 or 10 ECTS for transfer to your home university. Each term includes 15+ social events such as canoe trips, beach bonfires and a visit to the ARoS art museum.

Students from AU's international partner universities who are nominated by their home university pay no course fee; others apply as freemovers and pay a per-course fee in euros that depends on EU/non-EU citizenship, subject and credits (shown on each course page). Applications run 15 January – 10 March 2027.
highlights: No course fee for nominated partner-university students
Strong social programme in Denmark's top student city
aarhus-summer-university-2027.eligibility: Bachelor's and master's students (master's courses require a bachelor's degree); freemovers must meet English requirements. All nationalities; partner-university students can be nominated as exchange students.
how_to_apply: Sign up for the 2027 course list and choose a course
Check with your international office whether you can be nominated (partner universities)
Otherwise apply as a freemover between 15 January and 10 March 2027 with passport, transcript and English proof
Pay the course fee (freemovers) and book housing; request a visa invitation if needed
aarhus-summer-university-2027.costs: Partner-university nominees: no course fee. Freemovers: course fee in EUR per course (varies by EU/non-EU status, subject and ECTS; see course pages). AU's budget example per month: housing about EUR 570, meals EUR 240, social programme EUR 120.

accessed-hacks-2026.about:
AccessED Hacks asks participants to start from a learner's circumstances and build a small prototype that makes one learning task possible or meaningfully easier. Directions include translation and plain-language explanations, captions and audio alternatives, keyboard-friendly and readable interfaces, offline and low-bandwidth resources for older devices, and open educational resources.

Projects should show a believable before-and-after for a specific learner. New builders, designers, educators and experienced developers are all welcome. Submissions close on 20 November 2026; small cash prizes are offered.
highlights: Open to beginners, designers and educators
accessed-hacks-2026.eligibility: Open to participants worldwide who meet the Devpost rules (check minimum age on the Rules tab).
how_to_apply: Register on the official Devpost page
Join the organisers' Discord/discussion board to find teammates
Build your project during the hacking period
Submit code, demo video and description before the deadline

adroit-prizes-poetry-prose-2027.about:
The Adroit Prizes are awarded each year to two students of secondary or undergraduate status, one in poetry and one in prose, by guest judges who are established writers. All secondary and undergraduate students are eligible, including international students.

Poetry submissions can include up to five poems; prose submissions up to three pieces, and each student may send several submissions. Winners receive USD 200 and publication in The Adroit Journal alongside runners-up; finalists receive the judge's latest book. All entries are also considered for publication. The 2026 round has closed and the journal will reopen to submissions in spring 2027.
highlights: Open to high-school and undergraduate students worldwide
adroit-prizes-poetry-prose-2027.eligibility: Any secondary-school or undergraduate student in any country.
how_to_apply: Watch the Adroit Prizes page for the spring 2027 opening
Prepare up to five poems or three prose pieces
Submit online with a short cover letter
Pay the USD 15 fee or request financial assistance
adroit-prizes-poetry-prose-2027.costs: USD 15 submission fee (fee assistance form available).

al-akhawayn-summer-session-international.about:
Al Akhawayn University in Ifrane (AUI) is an English-medium, American-style public university in Morocco. Its Summer Session (early June to late July) and short intersessions (about 10 days in late May, August and winter) are open to international visiting students, who join regular university courses in business, science and engineering, and humanities and social sciences, and can also explore AUI's Arabic and North African Studies (ARANAS) programme.

International students live on campus with roommates. Applications are rolling through AUI's online form; costs depend on the number of courses and housing (2024–25 intersession package for an international undergraduate: 12,948 MAD including tuition, room, board and fees). It is a good way to combine credit-bearing study with Arabic, French and Moroccan culture.
highlights: English-taught courses at an American-style Moroccan university
On-campus living in Ifrane, Middle Atlas
Rolling applications; Arabic and North African Studies options
al-akhawayn-summer-session-international.eligibility: University students from any country (visiting / study-abroad students). English proficiency required.
how_to_apply: Read AUI's Summer Program for International Students page
Complete the online application form (rolling)
Agree course selection and credit transfer with your home university
Book on-campus housing and arrange a Moroccan visa if needed
al-akhawayn-summer-session-international.costs: Paid: tuition by credit plus on-campus room and board. 2024–25 international undergraduate intersession package 12,948 MAD (tuition, room, board, fees); partner-university students may get reductions.

ala-chevron-engineering-leadership-progr.about:
The Chevron Engineering Leadership Program (ALA ELP) is a STEM leadership camp hosted by African Leadership Academy and sponsored by Chevron. High-school students interested in engineering work in teams on hands-on design challenges, meet engineers and mentors, and build leadership and problem-solving skills alongside peers from across the continent.

The 2027 programme runs 28 June–11 July 2027 at ALA near Johannesburg. It is aimed at students aged 15–18 from across Africa with a strong interest in STEM; applications open in early 2027. Cost details are not published on the page; as a sponsored programme it has historically supported participants, so check the funding terms when applications open.
highlights: Mentorship from engineers and ALA faculty
ala-chevron-engineering-leadership-progr.eligibility: High-school students aged 15–18 from African countries with a strong interest in STEM and engineering.
how_to_apply: Watch ALA's short-programmes page for the early-2027 application launch
Complete the online application and essays
Provide school records and any references requested
Attend in Johannesburg from 28 June to 11 July 2027 if selected
ala-chevron-engineering-leadership-progr.costs: Sponsored by Chevron; the page does not publish fees. Confirm what is covered (tuition, board, travel) when applications open.

ala-global-scholars-program-2027.about:
The Global Scholars Program (GSP) brings teenagers from Africa and around the world to the African Leadership Academy (ALA) campus near Johannesburg for an immersive leadership experience. GSP Engage (15 days, 28 June–12 July 2027) focuses on human-centred design and entrepreneurial problem-solving; GSP Explore (10 days; 28 June–9 July, 19–30 July or 2–13 August 2027) focuses on self-awareness, goal-setting and leadership.

Participants live on campus with peers from many countries, work in teams on community challenges and join cultural excursions around Johannesburg. Fees differ for African residents and international students: Engage USD 4,250 / USD 5,250, Explore USD 2,800 / USD 3,500, plus a USD 25 application fee and USD 500 deposit.
highlights: Peers from across Africa and the world
Hosted at one of Africa's best-known leadership schools
ala-global-scholars-program-2027.eligibility: Young people aged 13–19 from any country (separate pricing for African residents and international participants). English is the working language.
how_to_apply: Choose GSP Engage or Explore and a 2027 session
Apply via ALA's Submittable form and pay the USD 25 fee
Pay the USD 500 deposit once accepted
Arrange flights and a South African visa if required
ala-global-scholars-program-2027.costs: Engage: USD 4,250 (African residents) or USD 5,250 (international); Explore: USD 2,800 or USD 3,500. Plus USD 25 application fee and USD 500 deposit. Flights extra.

ala-model-african-union-2027.about:
ALAMAU is African Leadership Academy's annual Model African Union, a simulation of the African Union rather than the UN. Delegates represent African member states and organs, debate and negotiate continental challenges, and take part in keynote talks, a diplomatic roundtable and a Cultural Night celebrating the continent's diversity.

The 2027 conference runs 17–21 March 2027 at ALA near Johannesburg. It is open to young leaders from secondary schools around the world; schools and delegations express interest through ALA's online form, after which the organisers share fees, committee allocations and logistics.
highlights: Simulates the African Union instead of the UN
Keynotes, diplomatic roundtable and Cultural Night
Secondary-school delegates from around the world
ala-model-african-union-2027.eligibility: Secondary-school students from any country, usually as part of a school delegation.
how_to_apply: Submit the ALAMAU expression-of-interest form on ALA's website
Receive fees, committee and country allocations from the organisers
Prepare position papers on your assigned African member state
Travel to Johannesburg for 17–21 March 2027
ala-model-african-union-2027.costs: Conference fee and accommodation are shared after the expression of interest; travel extra.

alif-fez-arabic-summer-2027.about:
The Arabic Language Institute in Fez (ALIF) is one of the best-known places to study Arabic in North Africa. It offers seven levels of Modern Standard Arabic from beginner to advanced, Moroccan Arabic (Darija) at beginner and intermediate levels, content courses in Arabic (media Arabic, Maghrebi literature, Islamic texts) and a North African Studies course in English.

2027 terms: Spring 1 (7 January–23 February), Spring 2 (3 March–16 April), a three-week May term (26 April–14 May), Summer 1 (26 May–6 July) and Summer 2 (16 June–27 July); six-week terms are 120 hours. Fees are 9,000 MAD for 3 weeks, 17,000 MAD for 6 weeks and up to 74,000 MAD for a full year, plus about 1,600 MAD for textbooks; private lessons and housing (homestays or apartments) can be arranged.
highlights: Seven levels of Modern Standard Arabic plus Darija
Two summer 2027 sessions in the old city of Fez
alif-fez-arabic-summer-2027.eligibility: Learners of Arabic of any nationality (university students and adults; ask ALIF about minimum age).
how_to_apply: Choose a 2027 term and course level
Complete the online application form
Book homestay or other housing through ALIF
Pay tuition before the term and arrange travel to Fez
alif-fez-arabic-summer-2027.costs: 3 weeks 9,000 MAD; 6 weeks 17,000 MAD; 12 weeks 31,000 MAD; textbooks about 1,600 MAD; refundable 300 MAD library deposit. Housing extra.

alx-africa-tech-career-programmes.about:
ALX Africa is one of the continent's largest tech-skills training providers. Its current programmes include AI Career Essentials (8 weeks, about 20 hours a week, no coding needed: AI foundations, prompting, responsible AI, content creation and data analysis with AI), Data Analytics (7 weeks: spreadsheets, SQL/PostgreSQL and Power BI), Data Science, Founder Academy (8 weeks: validating a startup idea, building an MVP, go-to-market and investor pitch), Freelancer Academy, Content Creation, Graphic Design and Virtual Assistant.

All are online and self-paced with immediate start, and include a Professional Foundations course and portfolio projects that lead to a certificate. Through a partnership with the Mastercard Foundation, eligible learners can access sponsored training for about USD 5 per month; eligibility (country, age) is checked on the enrolment page.
highlights: AI, data, entrepreneurship and freelancing tracks
Heavily subsidised for eligible African learners
alx-africa-tech-career-programmes.eligibility: Aimed at young people in Africa; eligibility for sponsored pricing (country and age) is confirmed at enrolment on ALX's portal.
how_to_apply: Choose a programme on alxafrica.com
Click Enroll Now and create an account on the ALX hub
Check eligibility for the Mastercard Foundation-sponsored price
Complete Professional Foundations and the programme projects to earn the certificate
alx-africa-tech-career-programmes.costs: Sponsored pricing of about USD 5 per month for eligible learners via the Mastercard Foundation; otherwise see the enrolment page.

antwerp-childrens-literature-summer-scho.about:
The University of Antwerp's Children's Literature Summer School runs 28 June – 2 July 2027. The 2027 theme, 'Body and Mind', is explored through lectures and interactive workshops from several disciplinary angles, plus two excursions.

It suits students and researchers in literature, education, psychology, media and publishing, as well as teachers and librarians.

Fees, scholarships and the application deadline are on the school's linked pages; apply through the Antwerp Summer and Winter University portal.
antwerp-childrens-literature-summer-scho.eligibility: Students, researchers and professionals interested in children's and YA literature.
how_to_apply: Read the school page.
Check fees and scholarships.
Apply via the Antwerp Summer and Winter University portal.
antwerp-childrens-literature-summer-scho.costs: Fee and scholarships on the school's fee page.

antwerp-crisis-governance-winter-school-.about:
Crisis Governance is a one-week University of Antwerp winter school, 1–5 February 2027, 'designed for tomorrow's crisis leaders'. Real-life case studies, interactive assignments and input from academics and industry professionals cover crisis communication, leadership frameworks and designing governance strategies.

It targets students and professionals heading for public service, corporate leadership or emergency management.

Scholarships are mentioned on the school's registration-fee page; applications are open via the Antwerp Summer and Winter University portal.
antwerp-crisis-governance-winter-school-.eligibility: Students and professionals in public administration, management, communication or emergency management.
how_to_apply: Read the school page and fee/scholarship page.
Apply via the Antwerp Summer and Winter University portal.
Meet the deadline listed on the school page.
antwerp-crisis-governance-winter-school-.costs: Registration fee and scholarships on the school's fee page.

antwerp-european-solidarity-winter-schoo.about:
European Solidarity in the Making is a University of Antwerp winter school, 1–5 February 2027. Experts from several disciplines examine the social and political dimensions of European solidarity, focusing on what solidarity means in the global context of international migration.

The week includes a field trip to Brussels to meet policymakers and discuss current EU debates, and activities in Antwerp with migrant-support organisations; participants present their findings to organisers and social partners.

A registration fee applies and scholarships are available. Apply through the Antwerp Summer and Winter University portal.
highlights: Field trip to EU policymakers in Brussels
antwerp-european-solidarity-winter-schoo.eligibility: University students (bachelor's/master's/PhD) and young professionals interested in migration, EU politics and social policy.
how_to_apply: Read the school page and its fee/scholarship page.
Apply via the Antwerp Summer and Winter University application portal.
Meet the deadline on the school's 'Application deadline' page.
Pay the registration fee (or apply for a scholarship).
antwerp-european-solidarity-winter-schoo.costs: Registration fee and scholarships listed on the school's 'Registration fee and scholarships' page. Travel and accommodation extra.

antwerp-film-history-summer-school-2027.about:
The University of Antwerp's Film History Summer School (4–10 July 2027) is built around two themes, with about twenty rare archival screenings in optimal cinema conditions plus expert lectures and in-depth seminars. The 2027 focus is 'Hollywood's "Other" Stars: Difference and the Business of Stardom in Classical Hollywood Cinema'; a second theme will be announced.

Participants practise close film analysis and connect theory with historical context.

It suits students and researchers in film, media and cultural studies. A registration fee applies and scholarships are available.
antwerp-film-history-summer-school-2027.eligibility: Students, researchers and professionals with an academic interest in film history.
how_to_apply: Read the school page and its fee/scholarship page.
Apply via the Antwerp Summer and Winter University application portal.
Meet the deadline on the school's 'Application deadline' page.
Pay the registration fee (or apply for a scholarship).
antwerp-film-history-summer-school-2027.costs: Registration fee and scholarships listed on the school's 'Registration fee and scholarships' page. Travel and accommodation extra.

antwerp-global-food-law-policy-2027.about:
Critical Approaches to Global Food Law and Policy is a University of Antwerp school with an academic module in Antwerp (1–5 February 2027) and a practitioner week in Rome (five days in late June or early July 2027, dates TBC). It covers how food is produced, circulated, consumed and governed in a globalised world, with links to sustainability, human rights and people's agency.

In Rome, participants visit and discuss with the Rome-based UN agencies, international NGOs and the EU.

It suits law, political science, development and agri-food students and young professionals. A registration fee applies; scholarships are available.
highlights: Rome week with UN food agencies
antwerp-global-food-law-policy-2027.eligibility: University students and young professionals in law, development, environmental and food studies.
how_to_apply: Read the school page and its fee/scholarship page.
Apply via the Antwerp Summer and Winter University application portal.
Meet the deadline on the school's 'Application deadline' page.
Pay the registration fee (or apply for a scholarship).
antwerp-global-food-law-policy-2027.costs: Registration fee and scholarships listed on the school's 'Registration fee and scholarships' page. Travel and accommodation extra.

antwerp-international-design-workshop-we.about:
The International Design Workshop week (IDW) is the University of Antwerp Faculty of Design Sciences' winter school, 8–12 February 2027. Master's students in interior architecture, product development, urbanism and spatial planning, heritage studies and visual arts work in interdisciplinary groups, each guided by an international pair of tutors.

The 2027 theme, 'LAST CALL', explores art and design in times of transition, legacy and heritage.

Fee, scholarships and the deadline are on the IDW page's linked sections; apply via the Antwerp Summer and Winter University portal.
antwerp-international-design-workshop-we.eligibility: Master's students in interior architecture, product development, urbanism/spatial planning, heritage studies and visual arts.
how_to_apply: Read the school page and its fee/scholarship page.
Apply via the Antwerp Summer and Winter University application portal.
Meet the deadline on the school's 'Application deadline' page.
Pay the registration fee (or apply for a scholarship).
antwerp-international-design-workshop-we.costs: Registration fee and scholarships listed on the school's 'Registration fee and scholarships' page. Travel and accommodation extra.

antwerp-responsible-fashion-management-2.about:
Responsible Fashion Management is a University of Antwerp summer school in one of Europe's fashion capitals. From 28 June to 2 July 2027 participants visit studios and companies in Antwerp and attend workshops and expert sessions on circular business models, responsible supply chains and branding.

From 5 to 7 July 2027 the group moves to Paris for expert lectures and behind-the-scenes visits to luxury houses focused on heritage craftsmanship and sustainability.

It is open to university students, industry professionals and entrepreneurs. Fees and scholarships are listed on the school's fee page.
antwerp-responsible-fashion-management-2.eligibility: University students, industry professionals and entrepreneurs.
how_to_apply: Read the school page.
Check the fee and scholarship page.
Apply via the Antwerp Summer and Winter University portal before the deadline.

antwerp-summer-school-vaccinology-2027.about:
The Summer School on Vaccinology is organised by the Centre for the Evaluation of Vaccination (CEV) at the University of Antwerp, with financial support from WHO/Europe. The 2027 edition runs 28 June – 5 July 2027 in Antwerp, Belgium.

The programme covers vaccine-preventable infectious diseases, vaccination programmes, vaccine-related immunology and vaccine safety, as well as how to communicate about and administer vaccines.

It suits medicine, pharmacy, nursing and public-health students and professionals. Fees, scholarships and the application deadline are on the school's linked pages; applications go through the Antwerp Summer and Winter University portal.
highlights: Run by a leading vaccine-evaluation centre
antwerp-summer-school-vaccinology-2027.eligibility: Students and professionals in medicine, pharmacy, nursing and public health (see the school's page).
how_to_apply: Read the school page and fee/scholarship page.
Apply via the Antwerp Summer and Winter University application portal.
Meet the deadline on the school's 'Application deadline' page.
Pay the fee.
antwerp-summer-school-vaccinology-2027.costs: Fee and scholarship details on the school's 'Fee and scholarships' page.

antwerp-sustainable-city-summer-school-2.about:
The Sustainable City: An Integrated Perspective is a five-day University of Antwerp summer school, 28 June – 2 July 2027. It looks at how cities can pursue sustainability by combining insights from the natural sciences, urban technology, the social sciences and the humanities.

City experts, practitioners and academics teach together, using Antwerp itself as a case study.

It suits students in urban studies, environmental science, engineering, planning, geography and social sciences. Fees, scholarships and deadlines are on the school's linked pages.
highlights: Taught by academics and city practitioners
antwerp-sustainable-city-summer-school-2.eligibility: University students and professionals interested in urban sustainability.
how_to_apply: Read the school page.
Check fees and scholarships.
Apply via the Antwerp Summer and Winter University portal.
antwerp-sustainable-city-summer-school-2.costs: Fee and scholarships on the school's 'Fee and scholarships' page.

apple-swift-student-challenge-2027.about:
The Swift Student Challenge invites students to create an original app playground in Swift (in Swift Playgrounds or Xcode) that can be experienced in about three minutes. Submissions are judged on innovation, creativity, social impact and inclusivity; Apple selects winners and, from them, Distinguished Winners who have been invited to Apple's Worldwide Developers Conference.

You must enter as an individual, and you can win up to three times. The challenge runs every year with a submission window usually in February, so the months before are the time to learn Swift and build your project using Apple's free resources on the 'Get ready' page.
highlights: Free, individual entry from most countries
Winners recognised by Apple; top entries invited to WWDC
Great portfolio project for CS applicants
apple-swift-student-challenge-2027.eligibility: Students who meet the minimum age for their country (13+ in most countries; 14–16+ in some, e.g. 16+ in Germany and the Netherlands), are registered as (free) Apple developers, and are enrolled in school, university, a STEM curriculum, or recently graduated. Not open to full-time employed developers.
how_to_apply: Register for a free Apple developer account
Learn Swift with Apple's free resources and plan your idea
Build your app playground (individual work only)
Submit during the official 2027 window and answer the written prompts
apple-swift-student-challenge-2027.costs: Free. A Mac or iPad helps for building in Swift Playgrounds/Xcode.

aspirantum-persian-summer-school-yerevan.about:
ASPIRANTUM's Persian Language Summer School in Yerevan offers 6 to 10 weeks of intensive Modern and colloquial Persian, starting on 20 June, 27 June or 4 July 2027 and ending by 27 August 2027. Students attend four classes every weekday (120-200 contact hours) with regular assignments, authentic materials and cultural activities; the full 10-week course introduces about 1,500 new words.

Levels run from beginner to upper-intermediate. It is aimed at students, researchers and professionals (18+) who want to learn Persian in a region with close cultural ties to Iran, without needing an Iranian visa.
highlights: About 1,500 new words in the full 10-week course
aspirantum-persian-summer-school-yerevan.eligibility: Adults aged 18+ of any nationality; beginners welcome.
how_to_apply: Read the programme page on aspirantum.com.
Choose start date and length.
Apply online by 15 May 2027.
Pay the fee and arrange travel and accommodation.
aspirantum-persian-summer-school-yerevan.costs: USD 5,990 for 10 weeks; USD 4,990 if paid by 15 December 2026; shorter options cost less.

aspirantum-russian-summer-school-yerevan.about:
ASPIRANTUM, a private school of languages and cultures in Yerevan, runs an intensive Russian summer school for international learners. Participants choose 6, 7, 8, 9 or 10 weeks, starting on 20 June, 27 June or 4 July 2027, with all sessions ending by 27 August 2027. Classes run four 50-minute lessons every weekday (120-200 contact hours) covering grammar, vocabulary, listening, speaking, reading and writing, with after-class cultural activities.

The programme targets adults aged 18+, mainly at upper-elementary to intermediate level. It suits university students of Russian, Eurasian or Caucasus studies who want immersion in a safe, Russian-speaking city with easy visa-free access for many nationalities.
highlights: Flexible 6-10 week format with three start dates
aspirantum-russian-summer-school-yerevan.eligibility: Adults aged 18+ of any nationality; designed mainly for upper-elementary to intermediate learners of Russian.
how_to_apply: Read the programme page on aspirantum.com.
Choose your start date (20 June, 27 June or 4 July) and length (6-10 weeks).
Submit the online application by 15 May 2027.
Pay the fee (discount if paid by 15 December 2026) and arrange travel to Yerevan.
aspirantum-russian-summer-school-yerevan.costs: USD 5,990 for 10 weeks; USD 4,990 if paid by 15 December 2026. Shorter programmes cost less. Travel and accommodation are arranged separately.

astw-asean-in-todays-world-2027.about:
ASEAN in Today's World (AsTW) is an annual short-term programme run by a consortium of Asian universities led by Kyushu University (Japan). The 2027 edition is hosted by Ateneo de Manila University in the Philippines from 21 February to 4 March 2027.

Participants take academic courses on ASEAN and East Asian affairs (politics, economics, society), meet peers from across Asia and beyond, and build intercultural communication skills through field activities.

It is for undergraduates (graduate students also considered) over 18 with a GPA of at least 3.0/4.0 and fluent academic English. Documents are due 30 November 2026.
highlights: Focus on ASEAN and East Asian affairs
Scholarships listed on the AsTW site
astw-asean-in-todays-world-2027.eligibility: Registered undergraduates (preferred) or graduate students over 18, GPA ≥3.0/4.0 (or B, 7.5/10), fluent academic English, continuing studies at home university after the programme.
how_to_apply: Download the application guidelines and forms from the AsTW admissions page.
Email documents by 30 November 2026 (consortium students to Kyushu; others to Ateneo's special programmes office).
Check the Fees and Scholarship pages.
Await selection results.
astw-asean-in-todays-world-2027.costs: Programme fee on the AsTW Fees page; scholarships described on the AsTW Scholarship page.

audencia-winter-program-2027.about:
Audencia, a triple-accredited French business school, runs an intensive Winter Program on its Atlantic campus in Nantes starting 11 January 2027. Students take one module per week for up to three weeks, earning 4 ECTS (2 US credits) per week and up to 12 ECTS, plus a certificate for a block of skills.

It is open to motivated bachelor's and master's students and young professionals with English at CEFR B2.

Independent applicants pay €150 admin fee plus €800 per module (after the early-bird date). Email winter@audencia.com by 5 November 2026; registrations close 19 November 2026.
highlights: Up to 12 ECTS in three weeks
audencia-winter-program-2027.eligibility: Bachelor's and master's students and young professionals; English B2 (test, English-taught studies, home certificate or native speaker).
how_to_apply: Choose your module(s).
Partner students: get nominated by 5 Nov 2026; independent applicants: email winter@audencia.com by 5 Nov.
Complete registration by 19 November 2026.
Pay fees and arrange travel to Nantes.
audencia-winter-program-2027.costs: €150 non-refundable admin fee; independent applicants €800 per module (€600 early-bird before 15 Oct); partner students pay no extra tuition.

ayn-rand-essay-contests-2027.about:
The Ayn Rand Institute runs annual essay contests on three of Ayn Rand's novels: Anthem and The Fountainhead (middle- and high-school students aged 13 and over) and Atlas Shrugged (high-school, college and graduate students). Students read the novel, choose one of the published prompts and submit an essay online; essays are judged on understanding of the book and quality of writing.

The contests are open to students worldwide (international students welcome) and free to enter, with up to USD 25,000 in scholarship prizes across multiple awards. Participants must be enrolled in school during the contest period. Next deadlines are listed as coming soon; the contests run every year.
highlights: Free to enter, open to students worldwide
Up to USD 25,000 in scholarship prizes
Separate contests for middle/high school and university
ayn-rand-essay-contests-2027.eligibility: Anthem and The Fountainhead: middle- and high-school students aged 13+; Atlas Shrugged: high-school, college and graduate students. Any country; must be enrolled in school.
how_to_apply: Choose the contest matching your level
Read the novel and the published prompts
Write your essay in English
Submit online before the 2027 deadline posted on the contest page

barnard-pre-college-summer-2027.about:
Barnard Pre-College runs summer institutes on its campus next to Columbia University in Manhattan. The NextGen Leadership Institute combines a three-week academic strand (Scientific Exploration, Literature & Performing Arts or Global Humanities) with leadership workshops; the Health & Society Institute looks at how culture, policy and inequality shape health; and the Athena Summer Innovation Institute guides teams through venture development to a final pitch.

Sessions run 28 June–16 July and 19 July–6 August 2027 (Athena in Session I only). Applications open 1 December 2026, the financial-aid and fee-waiver deadline is 15 February 2027 and the final deadline 15 April 2027. International students may enrol in these non-credit institutes (not the credit-bearing Pre-Baccalaureate), live in residence halls, pay the same tuition as US students and do not need an English test, but Barnard does not offer them financial aid or I-20 visa sponsorship.
highlights: Three institutes: leadership, health & society, innovation
No English test required; students of all genders welcome
barnard-pre-college-summer-2027.eligibility: High-school students meeting each institute's grade requirements; students of all genders. International students eligible for the non-credit institutes (not Pre-Baccalaureate). No TOEFL/IELTS required, but full English fluency expected.
how_to_apply: Pick an institute and session
Apply online from 1 December 2026
Request financial aid or fee waiver by 15 February 2027 (US students)
Submit by 15 April 2027
International students: check visa / ESTA rules (no I-20 is issued)
barnard-pre-college-summer-2027.costs: Same tuition for international and domestic students; residential or commuter pricing on Barnard's tuition page. No financial aid for international students.

baumun-train-2026.about:
BAUMUN TRAIN is the training-oriented conference of Bahçeşehir University's MUN club in Istanbul ('#WelcomeToBosphorus'), where participants are introduced to the skills and responsibilities of delegates while debating in full committees.

The conference runs 11–13 December 2026 at Bahçeşehir University South Campus (Beşiktaş, on the Bosphorus), Istanbul, Türkiye. It is open to high school and university students; designed to introduce newer delegates to MUN skills. Working language: English.

Apply via 'Apply' on the official site and choose your committee. The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. As at any MUN, delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions — hands-on training in public speaking, research and diplomacy that universities value.
highlights: The delegate fee is published on the official registration page
baumun-train-2026.eligibility: Open to high school and university students; designed to introduce newer delegates to MUN skills. Working language: English. No nationality restrictions are stated; international delegates (including from Georgia and Qatar) can apply, arranging their own visa and travel.
how_to_apply: Open the official website (link below) and read the conference information and committee list.
Apply via 'Apply' on the official site and choose your committee.
Pay the delegate fee by the stated deadline to confirm your place.
Prepare a position paper using the committee study guides before the conference.
baumun-train-2026.costs: The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. Travel, accommodation and visas are paid by participants unless stated otherwise.

berklee-aspire-five-week-summer-2027.about:
Aspire: Five-Week Music Performance Intensive is Berklee College of Music's largest summer programme. Students aged 15 and over are placed in ensembles by level and style, take private instruction and music classes, and live in Berklee housing in Boston. It draws students from more than 70 countries.

In 2026 it ran 9 July–13 August, with tuition USD 5,430 (USD 5,230 if enrolled by 31 January) and housing USD 4,200; 2027 should follow a similar timetable. Most Berklee summer programmes allow instant enrolment without an audition, and scholarships are available for Aspire. Shorter one-week workshops in Boston and Los Angeles are also offered.
highlights: Ensembles, lessons and classes at Berklee
No audition needed for most programmes; Aspire scholarships available
berklee-aspire-five-week-summer-2027.eligibility: Musicians aged 15 and over from any country; international students need a US visa.
how_to_apply: Check 2027 dates and pricing on summer.berklee.edu
Enrol online (by the end-of-January early-price date if possible)
Apply for Aspire scholarships if needed
Book Berklee housing and arrange a US visa
berklee-aspire-five-week-summer-2027.costs: 2026 reference: tuition USD 5,430 (USD 5,230 early), housing USD 4,200. 2027 prices to be published. Scholarships available.
